model.title: Protecting Investors’ Personally Identifiable Information Act
model.meta: Financial Services Committee · Rep. Barry Loudermilk (R-GA)

summary.text: The bill would prevent the Securities and Exchange Commission from requiring securities exchanges and their members to provide personally identifiable information of market participants for the Consolidated Audit Trail, a system used by regulators to track trading activity.
